title: START AT skips the rows before the given values of the ORDER BY columns
query: EVALUATE ALL ( Product[Category], Product[Color] ) ORDER BY Product[Category], Product[Color] START AT "Accessories", "Red"

source.quote: defines the rows to skip before the specified values according to the sort order specified in the ORDER BY section of EVALUATE
source.supports: the page shows this query shape and a result that begins at the given pair

source.quote: The second argument in the START AT statement defines the starting value in column 2 of the ORDER BY columns within the rows that meet the first value for column 1.
source.supports: the second value applies within the first

derivation: Sorted: (Accessories, Blue), (Accessories, Red), (Vehicles, Green), (Vehicles, Red). The result starts at (Accessories, Red), so the first row is skipped and three remain.
